title: Released-event-count and released-label MTL conditional-selection sensitivity

scope.source_membership: Every exact published NWB asset in the frozen source manifest; full original bytes verified before use; no unavailable-session exclusion.
scope.independent_unit_boundary: Recorded units are clustered within sessions and repeated patients. Unit/session keys do not establish distinct biological neurons across recordings.
scope.measurement_target: Order-invariant counts of released stored timestamp occurrences, including exact multiplicity, contrasted by the released original0/1 labels. These are not authenticated counts of unique physical spikes or independently verified exposure histories for every trial.
not_claimed: absence or equivalence of memory signals
every repeated timestamp is a distinct physical spike
complete independently verified old-image exposure histories

papers.correspondence: Faraut2018 supplies the 200ms-to-1700ms response interval; its behavioral exclusions, correctly recognized trials and bootstrap mean-selection method are not reproduced.
Chandravadia2020 describes the expanded NWB dataset; its one-second response interval and bootstrap selection are not reproduced.

source_policy.session_order: lexicographic full manifest NWB asset path, Unicode codepoint order
source_policy.session_key: exact full manifest asset_path, including directory and .nwb suffix
source_policy.unit_key: asset_path + '::unit=' + base10 source unit_id with no leading zero padding
source_policy.unit_order: session_order, then original zero-based NWB units table row; not sorted unit IDs
source_policy.trial_order: original zero-based NWB trials table row within the session; not sorted trial IDs
source_policy.unit_identity: asset_path plus source unit row and source integer unit_id; all must agree
source_policy.trial_identity: asset_path plus source trial row and source integer trial_id; all must agree
source_policy.text_decoding: Strict UTF-8 for HDF5 bytes; retain exact original strings, case, slashes and punctuation; no basename extraction or destructive ID normalization.

unit_region.relation: /units/electrodes and /units/electrodes_index reference electrode-table ROW positions, not electrode IDs
unit_region.ambiguous_empty_or_multiple_links: failed_precondition; never choose first link or invent peak channel
unit_region.selection: Include a unit iff its sole referenced location contains case-sensitive 'Hippocampus' or 'Amygdala'. If both strings occur, fail ambiguous anatomy.
unit_region.region: Hippocampus or Amygdala for included units; null for non-MTL units
unit_region.excluded_unit_retention: All source units remain in units.csv with included=false and exclusion_reason=non_mtl_location.
unit_region.quality_exclusions: none; no firing-rate, waveform, behavior, confidence, or isolation threshold

trials.selection: All and only phase exactly 'recog'; keep every other original row in trials.csv as non_recognition_phase.
trials.learning_labels: Preserve literal source tokens (including 'NA'); decoded class and learning-membership evidence are null for non-recognition rows.
trials.image_history_check: Record whether each recognition row's exact original full external_image_file string occurs among the SAME session's released learning rows. This is an audit measurement, not an inclusion/relabeling precondition. All original0/1 labels and recognition rows remain unchanged even when a code1 image is absent from those learning rows. No path normalization, basename comparison, response/correctness substitution or outcome-selected reversal.
trials.source_description_conflict: The released label-column description reverses new/old meanings. Retain its literal text. Original native-code/converter lineage plus complete-history sessions support code0=new/code1=old; the analysis preserves these released labels rather than following the erroneous description or changing them from partial image histories.
trials.incomplete_learning_history: The source audit finds160 code1 recognition rows across8 sessions whose full image paths are absent from the released learning rows; their true prior exposure is not independently established here. Keep all of them and report the per-session crosstab. Absence from a released learning table does not imply novel status and is not repaired by inventing missing rows.
trials.behavioral_exclusions: none; all recognition trials retained regardless of reported response, correctness or confidence
trials.finite_times: All four required timestamps finite for every row, with start_time==stim_on_time and stim_on_time<=stim_off_time. Recognition rows additionally require stim_off_time<=stop_time. Preserve all original learning stop_time values even if they violate the full temporal ordering; they are not response-window inputs. Never sort/reassign times or infer missing trial ends.
trials.empty_or_one_class_support: Keep the complete source ledger and all mapped MTL units; statistics use explicit insufficient_class_support, not a fabricated chance estimate. Counts remain defined for any existing recognition rows.
trials.learning_stop_time_exception: The fixed source contains97 learning rows in one session with stop_time before stim_on_time. Retain every literal row and count this diagnostic per asset. No recognition row has this defect. Matching a stored stop value to a same-phase TTL6 does not establish that the event ended the same biological learning trial.

clock.origin: one original arbitrary acquisition-clock origin, preserved across events, trials and spikes; no subtraction of first event, phase start or first spike
clock.timestamp_consistency: Event and experiment timestamp arrays exactly agree; event times finite and nondecreasing. TTL tokens such as '1.0' decode as exact finite integers, not digit stripping.
clock.trial_event_check: Each row's stored onset, stimulus offset and stop_time matches exactly one same-phase TTL1, TTL2 and TTL6 respectively; start_time equals stim_on_time. The stored stop field is distinct from stimulus offset. Exact TTL linkage does not prove correct same-biological-trial assignment for the disclosed learning stop-field anomalies; no reassignment is authorized.
clock.phase_lookup: Use the original learning/recognition experiment-ID mapping recorded in general/data_collection and acquisition descriptions; retain actual mapping in source_observed. Do not assume codes from a different session.
clock.spike_units: The spike_times dataset may have no literal unit attribute. Seconds are supported by NWB semantics and upstream common 1e6 conversion, not an invented measured attribute. Preserve null for absent literal attributes.
clock.spikes: All source ragged indexes valid and every stored timestamp finite. Original order can be nonmonotone. Count interval cardinality independently of order, preserving EVERY occurrence and its multiplicity. A stable sorted COPY is allowed for search-based counting; the original source stays unchanged. Never searchsorted an unsorted array, deduplicate, shift or infer/drop concatenated segments.
clock.stored_event_irregularities: The pre-count structural audit finds13 unordered units across7 sessions,20 adjacent downward steps and2046 duplicate timestamp occurrences beyond the first equal value. Zero raw-adjacent duplicate pairs does not mean timestamps are unique. Large backward jumps and repeats have unresolved physical origin; retain them as released records, not as verified distinct physical spikes.
clock.observation_intervals: Report units/obs_intervals and intervals/invalid_times presence. In their absence observation_coverage='unknown'; do not infer recording support from spike extrema or exclude response windows from those extrema.
clock.unexpected_observation_tables: Pause the structural gate before freezing if present; no unstated censoring or continuity assumption.

response.endpoint_arithmetic: Convert original onset/spike seconds to float64; start=onset+float64(0.2), end=onset+float64(1.7).
response.count_equation: spike_count = sum over EVERY released stored timestamp occurrence s of1[start<=s<end], independent of storage order and including exact duplicate occurrences
response.counting_fairness: Direct Boolean interval counts, stable-sorted-copy binary search, or an equivalent exact algorithm are accepted. Stable sorting is not a scientific exclusion or source mutation. No requirement to use a particular sorting/counting implementation, and no acceptance of deduplicated counts.
response.rank_input: integer spike counts, mathematically identical ordering/ties to rates divided by the common positive duration
response.no_truncation: Do not stop the window at stimulus offset or trial end. This fixed response interval can contain post-offset/question-related activity; it is not a pure visual or motor-independent response.

rank_statistics.support: Defined iff both class counts are at least1; otherwise status=insufficient_class_support and all U/AUC/p/direction fields null.
rank_statistics.u_old_twice: 2*number(old_count>new_count) + number(old_count==new_count), summed over every old/new pair; exact nonnegative integer
rank_statistics.test: independent-samples Mann-Whitney-Wilcoxon rank-sum; two-sided asymptotic with pooled-tie variance and continuity correction
rank_statistics.tie_sum: sum(t_g^3-t_g) over multiplicities of every distinct count in the pooled samples; exact integer
rank_statistics.all_tied_convention: If every pooled count is exactly equal: u_old_twice=n_old*n_new, auc_old=0.5, p=1, preferred_sign=+1.
rank_statistics.invalid_arithmetic: failed_precondition; no caught exception may become p=1 or AUC=0.5
rank_statistics.preferred_sign: +1 if unrounded auc_old>=0.5, else -1; the exact AUC tie chooses+1
rank_statistics.same_trial_auc: max(auc_old,1-auc_old); computed for every supported MTL unit, summarized only over full-data-selected units

repeated_halves.initialization: One global Generator(PCG64(0)) initialized once for the complete task, not per session/unit/repeat.
repeated_halves.traversal: repeat0..59 outer; then all MTL units in canonical session full-path/original-unit-row order; class0 draw then class1 draw for each supported unit
repeated_halves.class_support: At least4 recognition trials in EACH source class for that unit/session.
repeated_halves.unsupported: Retain all60 split rows as insufficient_class_support, no RNG draws, all train_membership entries false; false entries do NOT imply test membership for an unsupported split.
repeated_halves.sampling: For each class, call rng.choice(original recognition-position indices of that class, size=floor(n_class/2), replace=False, shuffle=True). Concatenate class0 then class1 draws. The remainder in original trial-row order is test membership.
repeated_halves.membership_identity: Write/read original trial row and trial ID through the source-keyed response axis; compressed recognition positions are internal only.
repeated_halves.training: Compute U_old, raw AUC and p on training counts only; selection uses p<0.05; preferred direction uses training AUC only.
repeated_halves.test: Compute test u_old_twice and auc_old on the complementary held-out membership. Directed test AUC is test_auc_old if train_preferred_sign=+1, otherwise1-test_auc_old. Never fold the test AUC or use full-data direction.
repeated_halves.diagnostic_vs_included: Compute test AUC for every supported split, including nonselected splits; included_in_conditional_summary is exactly the training-selected flag.
repeated_halves.partition_properties: Supported train/test disjoint, union exactly all recognition trials of that unit; no cross-session/unit mixing.
repeated_halves.conditional_mean: Equal-weight mean of directed test AUC over training-selected repeats for each unit; null if no selected repeats.
repeated_halves.eligibility: n_selected_splits>=5; eligibility does not require full-data selection.
repeated_halves.interpretation: Overlapping random halves are dependent. Conditioning final eligibility on total training-selection count is not independent outer validation; a trial's role changes across repeats.

aggregation.full_data_selected_same_trials: Equal-weight mean same-trial preferred AUC over full-data-selected recorded units.
aggregation.crossfit_selected_at_least_five_splits: Equal-weight mean per-unit conditional held-out AUC over units with at least5 training-selected repeats, regardless of full-data selection.
aggregation.selected_proportion: n_memory_selective / n_mtl_units; denominator includes all source-mapped MTL units, with separately reported full-test unsupported count; null only if denominator0.
aggregation.empty_population: Mean null and status=empty_population; counts exactly0; do not replace by0.5 and do not fail solely because the source produced no selected/eligible units.
aggregation.no_pooled_split_weighting: Do not average all selected split rows across units directly; differing split counts must not change unit weights.
aggregation.population_overlap: Report full-data-selected only, conditional-eligible only, both and neither among all MTL units.
aggregation.uncertainty: No confidence interval, clustered bootstrap, null/permutation, false-discovery or patient-level test is required or implied.
aggregation.direction_gate: none; held-out AUC can be below0.5; either mean can be larger and any source-derived selected fraction is permitted

verification_tolerances.counts_ids_masks_categories: exact; integers are not booleans; no float-to-int truncation or uint overflow
verification_tolerances.source_headers: type-aware exact values for literal strings/units/IDs/Boolean presence flags; original source hashes and frozen method object exact
verification_tolerances.categorical_authority: Selection, preferred direction, support and >=5 eligibility come from unrounded source-count arithmetic. Accepted rounding of p/AUC does not change those categories.
verification_tolerances.arithmetic: Recompute each scalar from the complete count/membership receipts, then per-unit and population summaries; use the corresponding published p or rate/AUC tolerance. No correlation, rank-shape, plausible-count, expected-outcome or prose-keyword gate.
verification_tolerances.domains: Counts>=0; U2 in[0,2*n0*n1]; probabilities/AUCs/proportions in[0,1]; rates>=0; source/category integer values exact. No NaN/Inf substitutions.

serialization.csv: UTF-8 comma-separated, one header, required columns present once; extra harmless columns allowed. Rows/columns may reorder when source keys are preserved.
serialization.csv_null: empty field only for a publicly nullable value
serialization.csv_boolean: 0/1 or case-insensitive true/false; no other numeric thresholding
serialization.csv_integer: Exact integral decimal or scientific notation accepted; reject Boolean tokens, nonfinite, fractional or precision-losing coercions.
serialization.json: Required keys present even when null; finite native numeric values, true Boolean fields, no duplicated keys; no NaN/Inf. Harmless descriptive outer keys allowed, but source identities, method object and named model/population families are closed.
serialization.npz: allow_pickle=False; required string axes Unicode, integer axes/counts signed or unsigned integer dtypes, membership Boolean, rates floating. Reject objects, Boolean count arrays and invalid integer casts. Additional harmless primitive arrays allowed.
serialization.order: Canonicalization uses exact keys, not row order. All NPZ axis/response/repeat permutations must update indices/arrays coherently. Source row fields are immutable identity values, not output row numbers.
serialization.software: Report actual nonempty string-to-string implementation versions; do not require the oracle's library identities for mathematically equivalent results.

sessions.csv.coverage: one row for every required87 original asset
sessions.csv.rules: literal_session_id comes only from /general/session_id and is empty if absent; do not invent one from date. Session key is asset_path, not literal_session_id. Counts recompute from complete ledgers.

trials.csv.coverage: every original trial table row, including learning/non-recognition rows
trials.csv.null_rule: source_label and image_in_learning are null exactly for non-recognition rows; literal source_label_token is always preserved. All required source times remain finite even for excluded phase rows.

units.csv.coverage: every original unit table row, including non-MTL units
units.csv.rules: Preserve source unit ID, table row, electrode row, electrode ID and original channel separately. region is null exactly when included=false. No peak-channel, numeric-ID coincidence or group-name substitute.

dimensions.R: sum over included units of their session's recognition-trial count

unit_key.rule: every included unit_key once; no excluded units

source_trial_row.rule: original local trial row of the unit's asset

trial_id.rule: original trial ID agreeing with trials.csv at that source row

spike_count.rule: nonnegative exact half-open original-source response count

train_membership.rule: rows correspond to repeat_id; columns to response rows; exact frozen RNG membership; allfalse for unsupported unit repeats

trial_counts.npz.coverage: Each (unit_key,source_trial_row) pair exists exactly once for every recognition trial in that unit's session. No other response pairs. All original IDs/labels agree with source ledgers.
trial_counts.npz.order: Any coherent permutation of unit_key, response rows or repeat_id is accepted, with response_unit_index and train_membership updated accordingly.

split_events.csv.coverage: every included MTL unit times all60 repeat IDs, including nonselected/unsupported repeats
split_events.csv.unsupported_rule: status=insufficient_class_support iff original n_new<4 or n_old<4. All support/statistic/direction fields nullable here are null, not zero support from interpreting an allfalse mask; both selection/inclusion flags false.
split_events.csv.supported_rule: All nullable fields are required finite/non-null under status=ok. Both classes exist in train/test. train_selected==included_in_conditional_summary; test_directed_auc can be below0.5 and is retained even for train_selected=false.

neurons.csv.coverage: every included MTL unit exactly once, irrespective of full-data/split selection
neurons.csv.rules: n_trials=n_new+n_old; full nullable values null only for empty class support, with memory_selective=false. n_usable_splits is0 or60 under this fixed source policy. n_selected_splits counts every training-selected split; conditional_auc is the mean over those splits when count>0, otherwise null. A mean based on1..4 splits remains diagnostic, while heldout_eligible is exactly count>=5.

results.json.rules: Both populations always reported. Headline scalar/status exactly select the declared population. n_patients counts distinct literal source subject IDs across required sessions, not units. n_split_events=60*n_mtl_units; overlap counts sum to n_mtl_units. Full-test defined+undefined sum to n_mtl_units. Empty population requires n_units0, mean_aucnull and empty_population status.

phase_experiment_ids.types: integer values from that session's source mapping

clock_mapping_counts.types: all nonnegative_integer; matching counts equal n_trials when the structural precondition passes

label_membership_counts.types: all nonnegative_integer and exactly source-derived; compare original full paths, never basenames. Positive code1_absent counts are retained, not a failure or relabeling rule.

unit_electrode_link_counts.types: all nonnegative_integer; zero/multiple0 and one=n_source_units when the source gate passes

stored_spike_diagnostics.all_unit_spikes_nondecreasing: true iff every original unit sequence has no adjacent decrease before any copy sorting
stored_spike_diagnostics.raw_adjacent_inversions: sum over source units of count(raw_s[j+1]<raw_s[j])
stored_spike_diagnostics.n_unordered_units: number of source unit sequences with at least one raw adjacent inversion
stored_spike_diagnostics.raw_adjacent_duplicate_spikes: sum over source units of count(raw_s[j+1]==raw_s[j]) in ORIGINAL stored order
stored_spike_diagnostics.duplicate_timestamp_occurrences: sum over source units of len(raw_s)-len(unique(raw_s)), comparing exact timestamp values; no cross-unit merging; computation is diagnostic only and must not deduplicate response counts

session_record.rules: Only compact measured observations are duplicated here. Do not copy every trial/unit row into metadata; those are public CSV ledgers. Literal absent HDF5 unit attributes remain null. Date strings remain source strings and never shift timestamps. Source nonmonotonicity and missing old-image learning membership are reported honestly, never forced true/zero. Additional harmless descriptive fields may be present, but the named identity/count objects remain closed and source-exact.
session_record.temporal_order_diagnostics: For each phase separately, count original rows failing start_time<=stim_on_time<=stim_off_time<=stop_time, using literal finite source values. Learning violations are retained and reported; recognition violations remain failed_precondition. The counts diagnose records, not corrected physical timing.

findings.md.grading: No keywords, exact phrasing, expected effect, selected fraction or between-method direction required.

failure_handling.source_or_computation_precondition: Exit nonzero and write parseable run_metadata.json/results.json with status='failed_precondition' and nonempty reason, plus nonempty findings.md; never publish a complete result or silently drop source sessions/units/trials.
failure_handling.resource_pilot: Explicit status='resource_pilot'; never accepted as a complete87-asset output or reference bank.
failure_handling.valid_empty_statistical_population: Not a precondition failure; retain complete source tables/counts, zero population counts and null means with declared statuses.
failure_handling.evidence_safety: Original sources read-only; fresh output/report destinations outside source tree; do not overwrite prior analysis evidence or follow symlinked destinations.

verifier_performance.source_bank: Generated only from authenticated original sources using an independently implemented count/statistical route; oracle output may be consulted only after construction for validation. Historical numerical reference is not an input.
verifier_performance.memoization: Within one verifier process, canonicalize and exactly validate source integer counts, labels, IDs, split masks and scientific contract before reusing cached rank/split statistics. Cache keys must cover the complete primitive scientific identity, not submitted summaries, approximate floats, file path or a claimed hash alone.
verifier_performance.not_refitting_each_mutation: Rank statistics are deterministic functions of exact counts/membership. Reference-derived statistics may be reused after exact primitive equality is established; all submitted scalar receipts, selected events, per-unit means and population arithmetic are still checked.
verifier_performance.input_mutation: Any changed count, label, key or membership must fail the source comparison or trigger a genuinely distinct cache key; never reuse acceptance on a lossy or partial identity.

structural_contract_revision.reason: All three initial complete-source attempts failed the prior all-row temporal-order precondition before full-cohort rank/split analysis or bank publication. Retained original structural metadata identifies97 learning-only rows with stop_time before onset in one asset; all8700 recognition rows satisfy temporal order.
structural_contract_revision.evidence_boundary: The original structural preflight checked exact same-phase TTL linkage but missed full within-row ordering. This correction follows one-asset numerical pilots and prefix response counting in failed full attempts; it is not represented as preceding all response counts. No response results were used to choose the correction.
structural_contract_revision.unchanged: All87 original source files, all recognition trials and released labels, unit selection, event multiplicities, onset-based response window, rank test, random sequence, selection thresholds, summaries and numerical tolerances remain unchanged.
structural_contract_revision.resolution: Keep all finite literal learning timestamps and diagnose non-analysis stop-field inconsistencies without reassignment, source rewriting, exclusion or invented chronology. Recognition timing remains a strict precondition.
